_doc: Curtain product catalog — track, fittings (end brackets, ceiling/wall brackets, gliders), and fabric. Hand-edited. Generators consume this and emit specs/_partials/curtain-quantity-<scope-id>.md.
_pricing_rule: Per-metre products (track, fabric) use baht_per_metre_min + _max. Per-unit fittings use baht_per_unit_min + _max. All prices are RANGES (placeholder until shopping confirmed).
_per_calc_rule:
Each fitting declares how its qty is computed per window:
  - 'per-window'              → 1 per window (× window qty)
  - 'per-track-metre'         → ceil(track_m_per_window × 100 / interval_cm) per window
  - 'per-curtain-width-metre' → ceil(fabric_m_per_window × 100 / covers_cm_per_unit) per window
The generator reads per_calc + the optional interval_cm / covers_cm_per_unit fields.
_sizing_assumption: Drop fits within the fabric bolt width (typical 280 cm bolt handles up to ~250 cm drop with hem/heading allowance). For taller windows that exceed the bolt, the math under-counts and the spec needs a hand-edit note. Verify in store.

ikea-vidga-track.name: IKEA VIDGA single-track curtain rail (cuttable, sold by length)
ikea-vidga-track.notes: Cuttable aluminium rail. Confirm exact VIDGA SKU on visit (sold in 140 cm or 280 cm lengths).

ikea-vidga-end-bracket.name: IKEA VIDGA end-bracket pair (one per track run)
ikea-vidga-end-bracket.notes: One pair per window. End-piece + connector for finishing the track ends.

ikea-vidga-mount-bracket.name: IKEA VIDGA ceiling/wall mount bracket (every 80 cm of track)
ikea-vidga-mount-bracket.notes: One bracket per ~80 cm of track. Builder picks ceiling-mount or wall-mount variant on site.

ikea-vidga-glider-pack.name: IKEA VIDGA glider/hook pack (one pack per ~2.4 m of curtain width)
ikea-vidga-glider-pack.notes: Pack of glider hooks (typically 24/pack). One pack covers ~2.4 m of finished curtain width.

ikea-fabric-280cm-white.name: IKEA SANELA / RITVA / similar — white curtain fabric, 280 cm bolt
ikea-fabric-280cm-white.notes: Placeholder — replace with the actual fabric (SANELA blackout, RITVA cotton, or HomePro alternative) after shopping. The 280 cm bolt is wide enough that drop fits horizontally for any window under ~250 cm height.
